europe_now.title: Ukraine escalates drone and missile attacks on Russia
europe_now.summary: Drone and missile strikes by Ukraine have killed at least 19 people in Russia and Ukraine. The attacks are part of an ongoing escalation in the conflict.

top_stories.title: Polish bus crash in Hungary kills twelve
top_stories.summary: A Polish pilgrimage bus overturned on a Hungarian highway, killing 12 people. The accident occurred during a religious trip.

top_stories.title: Spanish fighter jet downing drone over Romania
top_stories.summary: A NATO fighter jet shot down a drone over Romania, which is near the Ukrainian border. The incident highlights ongoing security concerns in the region.
